headline: Goa Club Fire Accused Surrender
summary: The Luthra brothers surrendered before a court in Goa after the Supreme Court rejected their plea for bail. They have been remanded to judicial custody.

headline: Club Owners Surrender After Bail Rejection
summary: Three primary accused in the Goa nightclub fire case surrendered following a previous Supreme Court order denying them relief. They appeared before the Mapusa court.

headline: Tarun Tejpal Surrenders in Goa
summary: Former Tehelka editor-in-chief Tarun Tejpal surrendered before a Goa court following a Supreme Court directive in his 2013 rape case. He was subsequently sent to jail to serve his sentence.

headline: AAP and Goa Forward Party Form Alliance
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party and the Goa Forward Party have formally announced a pre-poll tie-up for the 2027 Goa Assembly elections. Both parties stated that they are keeping their doors open for other like-minded forces.

headline: Traffic Restrictions on Porvorim Corridor
summary: Authorities have restricted traffic and banned two-wheelers on the newly inaugurated Porvorim elevated corridor following fatal accidents. The move comes just days after the infrastructure project was opened.

headline: Goa Anti-Conversion Bill Withdrawn
summary: The Goa government has pulled back on its proposed anti-conversion bill. Critics and observers questioned the necessity of the legislation.

headline: Goa Celebrates Chovoth
summary: Families across Goa are celebrating the festival of Chovoth by welcoming Lord Ganesha into their homes. The five-day celebration highlights faith and traditions throughout the region.

headline: Pilot Project to Electrify Fishing Canoes
summary: A new pilot initiative in Goa aims to transition traditional fishing canoes to electric power. Fifty vessels have been selected to be electrified under the project.

headline: Goa Reservoirs Below Capacity
summary: As the monsoon enters its final leg, reservoirs across Goa have not yet reached full capacity. Water levels remain a point of observation for authorities.
